subheader: Licence, hosting, hours, migration — over a stated period
lead: Each figure is a number with its unit and a line saying what it is measured against. A cost of ownership with no stated basis is a number chosen to win an argument.
note: The note carries the basis of the whole comparison: the period, the size of the organisation, the date the prices were taken.

figures.title: The label is the term
figures.text: A description list, so the pairing survives being read out of order.

figures.title: The unit is text, not styling
figures.text: So the figure is read as hours rather than as a smaller font.

figures.title: The basis is the third line
figures.text: Where the number came from, and what it excludes.

figures.title: Two to eight figures
figures.text: Fewer than two is not a comparison; more than eight is a table.
